---
title: Notebook
description: "Interactive dataset viewer running in the browser via WebAssembly"
---

An interactive dataset viewer that runs entirely in your browser through
WebAssembly (marimo + Pyodide) — no install, no server. Pick any of the 161
datasets, choose the columns and the number of rows, and browse the result.

The viewer installs the `pharmadata` package wheel via `micropip` and loads
datasets through its public API — the same data the package ships.
